paragraphs: Unless otherwise expressly stated or the context otherwise requires, when we refer to "we," "our," "us," "BARK," or "the Company" in this annual report on Form 10-K, we mean BARK, Inc. and its consolidated subsidiaries.

We believe that dogs and humans are better together and we aspire to be the world's favorite dog brand. We are a team of dog-obsessed people committed to delivering personalization at scale by satisfying each dog's distinct personality, preferences, and needs with the best products and services. Since our founding in 2011, we have happily served millions of dogs and their people.

We are an omnichannel brand that designs and develops proprietary products for dogs across two key brands: BarkBox and Super Chewer. All of our products are designed and developed in-house, and are BARK branded. We

leverage an ever-growing collection of first-party data, customer insights, and AI to deliver personalized products and experiences tailored to the needs of each and every dog we serve. We sell our products in two segments: Direct-to-Consumer ("DTC") and Commerce, through our network of retail partners, which currently spans over 50,000 doors nationwide and online marketplaces including Amazon, Chewy and TikTok.

We began our journey with a monthly-themed subscription of toys, treats, and chews, tailored to the needs of each customer based on their dog's size, play style, allergies, and more. By viewing each dog as an individual, and by creating magical experiences for our customers, we have been able to build lasting relationships with millions of dogs and their parents. Our customer service ("Happy Team") proactively engages around 175,000 customers each month. We use the valuable data from these customer interactions to inform the design and development of future products, and we leverage it along with AI technology to recommend additional products to our customers through cross-selling and Add-to-Box ("ATB").

As a leading U.S. dog toy brand by revenue, we continue to leverage our brand strength to compete in complementary consumable categories, such as treats and chews. These offerings support our core toy business and expand our total addressable market. To optimize profitability, BARK recently narrowed its consumables portfolio by discontinuing certain products, including kibble and dental. We believe this streamlined focus allows us to prioritize our core toy identity while improving operational efficiency and our profitability profile.
Large, growing, and resilient market for pet products:
According to the American Pet Products Association ("APPA"), annual spend on pets in the U.S. was approximately $158 billion in 2025, an increase of 3.7%, compared to 2024.
Dogs are the most popular pet in the U.S.:

According to the APPA, dogs are the most popular pet in the U.S., with approximately 71 million households--representing 53% of all U.S. households--having a dog as a member of their family. We believe we have an opportunity to significantly expand our customer base, both in the U.S. and globally.

We operate two business segments: DTC and commerce. Our DTC and commerce segments drive the majority of our revenues, representing 82.3% and 17.7% of total revenue in fiscal 2026, respectively. BARK remains focused on diversifying its revenue across segments and brands, including BarkBox, Super Chewer, and BARK Air.

The majority of our revenue in the toys category is derived from our subscription products that feature monthly themes of premium-quality BarkBox and/or Super Chewer toys and BARK-branded treats and chews that are delivered directly to a dog's home. Customers have the option to subscribe to these products on a one-month, three-month, six-month, or twelve-month basis. During the life of their subscription, we offer our customers incremental products via ATB, which allows us to cross-sell customers across our full portfolio of products.

We also sell our BarkBox and Super Chewer toys and BARK-branded treats and chews in retail stores and other e-tailers, significantly broadening our customer reach and raising awareness of the BARK brand. BARK products are currently sold in over 50,000 retail doors, including Target, TJ Maxx, Costco, Walmart, and PetSmart. Additionally, we sell our products on other online platforms including Amazon, Chewy and TikTok.

Announced in April 2024, BARK Air is a first-of-its kind air travel experience tailored to dogs. BARK Air is partnered with several charter companies offering premium flights for customers and their dogs. Interested parties

headings: Risks Related to Our Strategy
Our ability to execute our strategy depends on successfully navigating numerous challenges and uncertainties.
We may fail to acquire and retain customers in a cost-effective manner.
We depend on various digital channels to reach and engage current and potential customers.
We may be unable to sustain a high level of customer engagement, which could damage our brand and reputation.
We may not be able to accurately predict consumer trends, successfully introduce new products and services, improve existing products and services, or expand into new offerings.
Our success depends on our ability to recruit and retain senior leaders and key employees.
We face challenges due to our reliance on third party sales channels to sell and distribute our products.
Risks Related to the Macro-Economic Environment
We rely on consumer discretionary spending, which may be adversely affected by economic downturns and other macroeconomic conditions, events, or trends.
We may be impacted by global disruptions or disasters.
Changes in trade policy or the imposition of tariffs could affect our revenue and profitability.
Risks Related to our Manufacturing, Inventory and Supply Chain
Our business critically relies on a limited number of suppliers, manufacturers, and logistics partners.
We may face supply chain disruptions.
Shipping, which is subject to numerous risks, is a critical part of our business.
We may be unable to manage the complexities created by our omnichannel operations.

If we are unable to implement appropriate systems, procedures and controls, we may not be able to successfully offer our products, grow our business and account for transactions in an appropriate and timely manner.
We may not be able to successfully optimize, operate and manage our fulfillment centers and shipping services.
Risks Related to Our Industry
Our estimate of the size of our addressable market may prove to be inaccurate.
We may not be able to compete effectively in the dog products and services industry.
Risks Related to Information Technology and Cybersecurity
We are subject to risks related to online payment methods.
We rely on software-as-a-service ("SaaS") technologies from third parties.
Limitations on our use of "cookies" may impact our ability to cost-effectively acquire new customers.
We may be unable to maintain and scale our technology.
Our disaster recovery arrangements may be insufficient.
The security of our and our partners' computer networks and databases containing personal information may be compromised.
Risks Related to Our Intellectual Property
We may be unable to adequately protect our intellectual property rights.
We may be subject to intellectual property infringement claims or other allegations.
Risks Related to Government Regulation and Legal Proceedings
We are subject to federal and state and foreign laws and regulations relating to privacy, data protection, advertising and consumer protection.
We are subject to product safety, labor, or other laws.
We are subject to extensive governmental regulation.
We may be adversely affected by changes in tax laws, rules or regulations.
Current and future litigation could have a material adverse effect on our business.
General Risks Related to Our Business
Our estimates or judgments relating to our critical accounting policies could prove to be incorrect.
We may be unable to accurately forecast our revenue and appropriately plan for our expenses in the future.
We have in the past and may in the future identify material weaknesses in our internal control over financial reporting.
Certain of our key performance indicators are subject to inherent challenges in measurement, and real or perceived inaccuracies.

paragraphs: The following discussion and analysis provides information which management believes is relevant to an assessment and understanding of our consolidated results of operations and financial condition. The discussion should be read in conjunction with the audited consolidated financial statements and notes thereto contained in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. This discussion contains forward-looking statements and involves numerous risks and uncertainties, including, but not limited to, those described in the "Risk Factors" sections of this Annual Report on Form 10-K. Actual results may differ materially from those contained in any forward-looking statements. Unless the context otherwise requires, references to "we", "us", "our", "the Company" and "BARK" are intended to mean the business and operations of BARK, Inc. and its consolidated subsidiaries. The audited consolidated financial statements as of March 31, 2026 and 2025 and for the fiscal years ended March 31, 2026, 2025 and 2024, respectively, present the financial position and results of operations and cash flows of BARK, Inc. and its wholly-owned subsidiaries.

We believe that dogs and humans are better together and we aspire to be the world's favorite dog brand. We are a team of dog-obsessed people committed to delivering personalization at scale by satisfying each dog's distinct personality, preferences, and needs with the best products and services. Since our founding in 2011, we have happily served millions of dogs and their people.

We are an omnichannel brand serving dogs across two key brands: BarkBox and Super Chewer. All of our products are designed, developed, and branded by BARK. We leverage an ever-growing collection of first-party data, customer insights, and artificial intelligence ("AI") to deliver personalized products and experiences tailored to the needs of each and every dog we serve. We sell our products in two segments: Direct To Consumer ("DTC") and Commerce through our network of retail partners, which currently spans over 50,000 doors nationwide and online marketplaces including Amazon, Chewy and TikTok.

We believe that our performance and future success depend on several factors that present significant opportunities for us but also pose risks and challenges, including those discussed below and in the section of this Annual Report on Form 10-K titled "Risk Factors."

Our ability to increase the number of customers. total orders, and cross-category purchasing is a key factor in our future DTC growth and will be driven by our marketing efforts and ability to continue to expand our product offerings. As a result, we expect to continue to focus on long-term growth through investments in product offerings and the dog and dog parent experience. We are working to enhance our offerings and expand the breadth of the products. We will remain flexible, adjusting our marketing spend up or down, based on the returns.

Another key factor in our future performance is our ability to increase our average order value ("AOV"), which involves introducing new products into our portfolio. We expect to continue to invest in the expansion of our product offerings, as we seek to attract new customers as well as growing sales with our existing customers. This expansion may require additional financial investments in headcount, marketing, customer acquisition expenses, operational capabilities and inventory. If we are unable to generate sufficient demand for these new offerings, we may not recover the financial investments and revenue may not increase as desired.

Our commerce segment continues to be an important growth driver for the business and our ability to expand our product assortment within both new and existing retail partners remains a focus area. This expansion may also require increased investments in trade marketing, merchandising support, and logistics capabilities. If we are unable
to successfully grow our retail presence or maintain strong partnerships, our ability to reach new customers and drive incremental revenue may be limited.

Market factors and international events, such as continued changes to trade policy, including the imposition of tariffs or changes in tariff rates, inflation, in particular as driven by the conflict with Iran, market effects of other global conflicts, and rising tensions with China, create business uncertainty and could further exacerbate rising interest rates, higher fuel and energy costs and commodity prices, reductions in net worth based on market declines, increases in housing costs, decreases in credit availability and rising consumer debt levels, which could impact our costs of doing business and the levels of discretionary consumer spending on our products and services and our financial results.

On February 20, 2026, the U.S. Supreme Court held that tariffs imposed under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act ("IEEPA") were unconstitutional. On April 20, 2026, CBP launched its Consolidated Administration and Processing of Entries ("CAPE") portal to process refund claims.

The Company paid a total of $15.4 million in IEEPA tariffs on imported goods between February 4, 2025 and February 24, 2026. Our recovery of IEEPA tariffs represents a loss recovery. To date, the Company submitted claims that were accepted by the CAPE portal in the amount of $3.3 million and a corresponding refund receivable was recorded within accounts receivable, net in the Company's consolidated balance sheet as of March 31, 2026. Of the $3.3 million, $2.7 million, and $0.6 million were recorded as reductions of cost of revenue, and inventory, respectively. An additional $7.1 million and $5.0 million of the IEEPA tariffs paid by the Company allocable to cost of revenue and inventory, respectively, for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 were not recorded. These amounts are not currently eligible for submission under the CAPE portal and therefore the Company was unable to recognize any receivable or loss recovery with respect to these amounts.

None of the IEEPA tariffs paid by the Company were passed through to our customers or are owed to our vendors or suppliers. The Company will pursue all actions necessary to recover the remaining amounts of IEEPA tariffs paid by the Company.

We cannot predict the duration or magnitude of the risks and challenges discussed above. Please refer to the "Cautionary Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements" and those factors described under "Risk Factors" in this Annual Report on Form 10-K.

On April 1, 2026, we effected a 1-for-20 reverse stock split of our common stock (the "Reverse Stock Split"), and our common stock began trading on a split-adjusted basis on April 1, 2026. Accordingly, all share and per share amounts presented in these consolidated financial statements and the accompanying notes have been retroactively adjusted, where applicable, to reflect the Reverse Stock Split.

我們認為狗與人類相處更好，我們致力於成為全球最受歡迎的狗品牌。我們是一羣對狗極其熱愛的團隊，致力於透過提供最佳的產品與服務，滿足每隻狗獨特的性格、偏好與需求，實現大規模的個人化。自2011年成立以來，我們已為數百萬隻狗及其主人提供服務。
我們是一個全通路品牌，為狗設計與開發專屬的產品，主要透過兩個品牌：BarkBox 和 Super Chewer。我們所有產品皆為自製，並以 BARK 品牌銷售。我們
運用不斷增長的第一方資料、客戶洞察與人工智慧，提供符合每隻狗需求的個人化產品與體驗。我們透過兩個業務區段銷售產品：直接對消費者（"DTC"）與通路業務，透過我們的零售合作夥伴網路，目前已遍及全國超過 50,000 個門市與線上市場，包括 Amazon、Chewy 和 TikTok。

我們的旅程從每月主題的玩具訂閱服務開始，包含玩具、零食與咀嚼物，根據每隻狗的體型、玩耍方式、過敏情況等需求進行個性化設計。透過將每隻狗視為獨特個體，並為客戶創造魔法般的體驗，我們已與數百萬隻狗及其主人建立長久的關係。我們的客服團隊（"Happy Team"）每月主動與約 175,000 名客戶互動。我們運用這些客戶互動所產生的寶貴資料，用以指導未來產品的設計與開發，並搭配人工智慧技術，透過交叉銷售與 Add-to-Box（"ATB"）推薦更多產品給客戶。
作為美國收入最高的狗玩具品牌之一，我們持續運用品牌優勢，在零食與咀嚼物等補充性消費類別中競爭。這些產品支持我們的核心玩具業務，並擴大我們的總可達市場。為優化獲利，BARK 最近已縮減其消耗品產品組合，停止銷售部分產品，包括狗糧與牙齒護理產品。我們認為這種精簡的聚焦有助於我們優先強化核心玩具品牌，同時提升運營效率與獲利能力。
大型、快速成長且具韌性的寵物產品市場：
根據美國寵物產品協會（"APPA"）的資料，2025 年美國在寵物上的年度支出約為 158 十億美元，相比 2024 年成長 3.7%。
狗是美國最受歡迎的寵物：
根據美國寵物產品協會（APPA）的資料，狗是美國最受歡迎的寵物，約有 71 百萬戶家庭—佔所有美國家庭的 53%—擁有狗作為家庭成員。我們認為我們有機會大幅擴展客戶羣，不僅在美國，也在全球範圍內。
我們經營兩個業務分部：DTC 和通販。我們的 DTC 和通販分部驅動了我們絕大部分的營業收入，分別佔 2026 財年總營業收入的 82.3% 和 17.7%。BARK 始終專注於跨分部和品牌擴散收入，包括 BarkBox、Super Chewer 和 BARK Air。
我們在玩具類別中的絕大部分收入來自於我們的訂閱產品，這些產品以每月主題形式提供高品質的 BarkBox 和/或 Super Chewer 玩具以及 BARK 品牌的零食和咀嚼玩具，直接送達狗的家中。客戶可以選擇以一個月、三個月、六個月或十二個月為單位訂閱這些產品。在訂閱期間，我們透過 ATB 提供客戶增量產品，這使我們能夠跨我們所有產品組合進行交叉銷售。

我們也透過零售商店和其他電商銷售我們的 BarkBox 和 Super Chewer 玩具以及 BARK 品牌的零食和咀嚼玩具，大幅擴展了我們的客戶羣並提高 BARK 品牌的知名度。BARK 產品目前在超過 50,000 個零售點銷售，包括 Target、TJ Maxx、Costco、Walmart 和 PetSmart。此外，我們也在其他線上平台銷售產品，包括 Amazon、Chewy 和 TikTok。

paragraphs: 以下討論與分析提供資訊，管理階層認為此資訊與評估及瞭解我們合併財務成果與財務狀況有關。討論應與本年度10-K表格年報所附之審計合併財務報表及其附註一併閱讀。此討論包含前瞻性陳述，並涉及許多風險與不確定性，包括但不限於本年度10-K表格年報所附「風險因素」部分所述之風險。實際結果可能與任何前瞻性陳述所載內容有重大差異。除非上下文另有明確要求，否則提及「我們」、「我們」、「我們」、「本公司」及「BARK」均指BARK, Inc.及其合併子公司之業務與營運。截至2026年3月31日及2025年3月31日之審計合併財務報表，以及2026財年、2025財年及2024財年截至3月31日之財務狀況、營運成果與現金流，均反映BARK, Inc.及其 wholly-owned 子公司之財務狀況與營運成果與現金流。
我們相信狗與人類在一起更好，我們致力於成為世界上最受歡迎的狗品牌。我們是一羣熱愛狗的團隊，致力於透過提供最佳產品與服務，滿足每隻狗獨特的性格、偏好與需求，實現大規模個人化。自2011年成立以來，我們已為數百萬隻狗及其飼養者提供服務。

我們是一個跨通路品牌，服務狗的兩個主要品牌：BarkBox與Super Chewer。我們所有產品均由BARK設計、開發與品牌化。我們利用不斷增長的第一方資料、客戶洞察與人工智慧（"AI"），為我們服務的每隻狗提供個性化產品與體驗。我們透過兩個業務段落銷售產品：直接對消費者（"DTC"）與透過我們零售夥伴網路進行販售，目前美國境內與線上市場包括Amazon、Chewy與TikTok等，已達50,000家門市。
我們相信，我們的表現與未來成功取決於幾個因素，這些因素為我們帶來重大機會，但也伴隨風險與挑戰，包括以下所述及本年度10-K表格年報所附「風險因素」部分所述之因素。
我們增加客戶數量、總訂單數與跨類別購買能力，是我們未來DTC成長的關鍵因素，將由我們的行銷努力與持續擴充產品組合的能力所驅動。因此，我們預期會繼續透過投資產品組合與狗與狗飼養者體驗，來追求長期成長。我們正在努力提升我們的產品組合與擴充產品種類。我們將保持靈活，根據回報調整行銷支出。
我們未來表現的另一個關鍵因素是我們提高平均訂單價值（"AOV"）的能力，這涉及將新產品引入我們的產品組合。我們預期會繼續投資於產品組合的擴張，以吸引新客戶並提升現有客戶的銷售。這種擴張可能需要在人力、行銷、客戶獲取費用、運營能力與存貨方面增加財務投資。如果我們無法為這些新產品產生足夠需求，我們可能無法回收財務投資，且收入可能無法如預期增加。
我們的通路業務段落持續為業務的重要成長動力，我們在新舊零售夥伴中擴充產品種類的能力仍是重點領域。這種擴張也可能需要增加在貿易行銷、商品支援與物流能力方面的投資。如果我們無法
成功擴展零售據點或維持強勁的合作關係，我們接觸新客戶與推動增量收入的能力可能受到限制。
總體經濟因素及國際事件，例如持續的貿易政策變動，包括課徵關稅或關稅率變動、通貨膨脹，特別是由與伊朗的衝突所驅動、其他全球衝突的市場影響、與中國日益升高的緊張關係，造成商業不確定性，並可能進一步加劇升高的利率、燃料與能源成本及商品價格、基於市場下跌的淨資產減少、住宅成本增加、信貸可得性下降及消費者債務水平上升，這些都可能影響我們的營運成本及消費者對我們產品與服務的自願支出水準與我們的財務結果。
2026 年 2 月 20 日，美國最高法院裁定根據國際緊急經濟權力法（"IEEPA"）課徵的關稅違憲。2026 年 4 月 20 日，國稅局（CBP）啟用其統合申報與處理入口（"CAPE"）入口網站以處理退款聲請。

本公司於 2025 年 2 月 4 日至 2026 年 2 月 24 日期間，為進口商品支付總計 15.4 百萬美元的 IEEPA 關稅。我們對 IEEPA 關稅的回收代表損失回收。截至目前為止，本公司提交的聲請經 CAPE 入口網站接受的金額為 3.3 百萬美元，並在本公司 2026 年 3 月 31 日合併財務報表的應收款淨額中記錄對應的退款應收款。在這 3.3 百萬美元中，2.7 百萬美元與 0.6 百萬美元分別被記錄為營業收入成本的減項與存貨的減項。此外，本公司於 2026 年 3 月 31 日會計年度內支付的 IEEPA 關稅中，屬於營業收入成本與存貨的金額分別為 7.1 百萬美元與 5.0 百萬美元，尚未記錄。這些金額目前不具備提交至 CAPE 入口網站的資格，因此本公司無法就這些金額認列任何應收款或損失回收。
本公司支付的 IEEPA 關稅中，無任何一筆已轉嫁至我們的客戶或應支付給我們的供應商或供應鏈夥伴。本公司將採取所有必要措施以回收本公司支付的 IEEPA 關稅餘額。
我們無法預測上述討論的風險與挑戰的持續時間或影響程度。請參閱本年度報告 10-K 表單中的 "警示性聲明" 以及 "風險因素" 部分所描述的相關因素。
2026 年 4 月 1 日，本公司實施了 1 股換 20 股的反向股票分割（"反向股票分割"），本公司普通股於 2026 年 4 月 1 日開始以分割調整後的基數進行交易。因此，這些合併財務報表及相關附註中所呈現的股數與每股金額，已根據適用情況進行追溯調整，以反映反向股票分割的影響。

headings: 與我們策略相關的風險
本公司執行策略的能力取決於成功應對 numerous challenges 和 uncertainties。
本公司可能無法以成本效益的方式取得並留住客戶。
本公司依賴各種數位通路以接觸並與現有及潛在客戶互動。
本公司可能無法維持高層級的客戶參與度，這可能會損害本公司品牌與聲譽。
本公司可能無法準確預測消費者趨勢、成功推出新產品與服務、改善現有產品與服務，或拓展至新業務領域。
本公司成功取決於本公司招募並留住高階領導人及關鍵員工的能力。
本公司因依賴第三方銷售通路銷售與分發產品而面臨挑戰。
與總體經濟環境相關的風險
我們依賴消費者非必需開支，此開支可能因經濟衰退或其他總體經濟條件、事件或趨勢而受到不利影響。
我們可能受到全球性幹擾或災難的影響。
貿易政策的變更或關稅的課徵可能影響我們的營業收入與獲利能力。
與我們製造、存貨及供應鏈相關的風險
我們的業務極度依賴有限數量的供應商、製造商及物流夥伴。
我們可能面臨供應鏈中斷的風險。
運輸，其受到眾多風險影響，是我們業務中的關鍵部分。
本公司可能無法管理由多渠道營運所造成的複雜性。
若本公司無法實施適當的系統、程序及控制措施，可能無法成功推廣本公司產品、拓展業務並以適當且及時的方式處理交易。
本公司可能無法成功優化、營運及管理本公司倉儲中心與運輸服務。
與本公司產業相關的風險
本公司對可接觸市場規模的估計可能證明不正確。
本公司可能無法在寵物用品及服務產業中有效競爭。
與資訊科技及網路安全相關的風險
本公司面臨與線上付款方式相關的風險。
本公司依賴第三方提供的軟體即服務（"SaaS"）技術。
對我們使用"cookies"的限制可能影響我們以成本效益方式取得新客戶的能力。
我們可能無法維持並擴展我們的技術。
我們的災難復原措施可能不足。
本公司及合作夥伴的電腦網路與儲存個人資料的資料庫之安全性可能遭侵害。
與智慧財產權有關的風險
我們可能無法充分保護我們的智慧財產權。
我們可能面臨智慧財產權侵權指控或其他指控。
與政府規範及法律程序相關的風險
本公司受美國聯邦政府、州政府及外國政府有關隱私權、資料保護、廣告及消費者保護之法律與規範所規範。
本公司受產品安全、勞工或其他法律所規範。
本公司受廣泛政府規範所規範。
本公司可能因稅法、規則或規範之變更而受到不利影響。
目前及未來之訴訟可能對本公司業務造成重大不利影響。
與本公司業務相關之一般風險
本公司有關關鍵會計政策之估計或判斷可能證明為錯誤。
本公司可能無法準確預測未來的營業收入，並適當地規劃未來的費用。
本公司過去曾且可能未來會發現重大弱點，影響財務報導的內部控制。
部分本公司關鍵績效指標在衡量時存在本質上的挑戰，且可能出現實際或被認為不準確的情況。
paragraphs: 投資本公司的證券涉及高度風險。您應仔細考慮下列所描述的風險，以及本年度報表（Form 10-K）中其他資訊，包括我們的合併財務報表及相關附註，以及「管理層對財務狀況與營運結果之討論與分析」。除非文意另有明確要求，否則提及「我們」、「我們」、「我們」、「本公司」及「BARK」均指 BARK, Inc. 以及其合併子公司之業務與營運。我們的業務、前景、財務狀況或營運結果可能因任何上述風險，以及我們未知或認為在本年度報表（Form 10-K）截止日不重要之其他風險而受到損害。我們證券之交易價格可能因任何上述風險而下跌，因此您可能損失全部或部分投資。此外，目前未知或我們認為不重要之其他風險與不確定性也可能影響我們之業務營運。本年度報表（Form 10-K）亦包含涉及風險與不確定性之預測性陳述。我們實際結果可能因多種因素而與預測性陳述中所預期者有重大差異，包括下列所描述之風險。請參閱「預測性陳述之警示說明」。
我們過去之營運表現可能無法反映未來之營運表現，未來之營運表現取決於我們能否成功執行策略，同時克服眾多挑戰與不確定性，包括但不限於下列事項：
•取得新客戶或保留現有客戶之成本或其他問題；
•對運送與履行服務及成本之不利影響，包括與現行關稅之課徵及未來關稅率不確定性相關之影響，以及運送航線限制及/或勞工罷工；
•消費者趨勢與偏好及/或可支配支出之變動，此將對我們之營業收入產生負面影響；
•因科技系統故障、網路安全事件或勞工短缺而導致業務中斷；
